parsed.compliance_time_text: For Group 1 aeroplanes (s/n up to 1363 inclusive): within 25 flight hours after 15 August 2024 [the effective date of the original issue of this AD], deactivate the Advanced Start System in accordance with SB-773-CS. Group 2 aeroplanes (s/n 1364 and up) have no deactivation requirement. (Re)activation of the Advanced Start System is allowed provided SB-826-CS has been embodied.
